_rule: External research says what the wider ecosystem does. It never overrides own-account analytics; disagreements are recorded.

findings.claim: Diwali 2026 spans five days Nov 6-10 with Lakshmi Puja on Sunday Nov 8; outbound travel from metro hubs peaks Nov 5-7, so week 2026-11-02 is the in-week homecoming window and its last day IS Diwali.
Northern Railway planned 6,200+ special train trips for the Diwali/Chhath rush, about 30% more than last year's 4,666, because trains on homebound routes sell out fast (Oct 27, 2026).

Diwali homecoming got costlier: trains full, one-way airfares crossing Rs 19,000 at preferred timings, private sleeper buses Rs 4,000-7,000, roughly Rs 2,000 above last year; working professionals are carpooling or skipping the trip (Oct 28, 2026).

Mpower 'Unpack Your Emotional Baggage' 2026 survey: nearly half of young Indians navigate emotional distress alone and only 9.2% seek professional help, yet 62.2% say they would listen without judgment if a friend reached out (Oct 1, 2026).
findings.source: Startup Success Stories coverage of Mpower 2026 survey (Oct 1, 2026)

findings.claim: Cancelling plans has become a guilt-relief tension in friendships: the relief of a cancelled plan used to be a guilty secret hidden behind elaborate apologies; writers argue good friendships survive honest 'I need to save my energy' (Feb 2026).
Instagram's own ranking signals that matter most for Reels are watch time, likes per reach and sends per reach, per Adam Mosseri; staying on-topic keeps audience signals working (Oct 19, 2026).
findings.source: Buffer, How the Instagram Algorithm Works 2026 (Oct 19, 2026)
